timeline.description: The government-appointed AI Commission publishes an advisory recommendation to establish a Swedish AI safety institute able to host a testing laboratory.
timeline.short: Advisory recommendation for a Swedish AI safety institute.

claims.text: The AI Commission's report says an annual grant of SEK 30 million is needed to run the institute and that a SEK 50 million research fund should be linked to it.
The government has tasked it with being the contact point for companies that make advanced AI models.
PTS says the government assignment includes being the market-surveillance authority responsible for certain prohibited AI uses and certain high-risk AI systems.
The government's decision makes Swedac, in all other respects, the notifying authority responsible for designating and notifying conformity-assessment bodies under the AI Act.
